notes: Knuffle Bunny Too centres on Trixie discovering another child (Sonja) has an identical Knuffle Bunny, the bunnies getting swapped at school, and a late-night resolution when the girls' dads swap them back. Key communicative concepts are: the bunny itself (hero), going to school, the swap/mix-up, crying/distress, nighttime, dads, and friendship. The word 'same' is a fringe inclusion here because it is the central plot trigger — both bunnies look the same — even though 'same' also appears in core row 2; consider whether to duplicate or rely on core row. Secondary character Sonja is a named child but appears only as a generic girl figure in Boardmaker so does not require sourcing. The mixed-media photographic-background art style means classroom/school images from Boardmaker will be acceptable approximations.
